association.definition: A shot 'follows' a pattern event if it occurs 1-60s after one.
association.note: Association only. Small counts; no control for shot quality, opponent or match state.

scenarios.name: Alternative A: switch the attack to the right flank
scenarios.action: Play the left-flank actions down the right flank instead.
scenarios.label: HEURISTIC SCENARIO ANALYSIS - not a prediction of what would have happened
assumptions: The right flank would convert actions into shots at its measured rate elsewhere in the match.
Opponent defenders would not adapt to the switch.
The same players could attack the other flank with the same effectiveness.
scenarios.benefit: Attacks the side the opponent may be weaker on, and makes the pattern less predictable.
scenarios.trade_off: Gives up whatever advantage the original flank was producing; the other flank may be weaker.
